rawContent: @HeyTammyBruce People like Swetnick and the creepy porn lawyer should be thrown in jail for undermining the #MeToo movement and using the grief of actual sexual assault victims for their petty personal benefit.

@rohini_sgh At least you can take the liberty of calling out this lady. Had a man done it, he would have been labeled a misogynistic pig and got abused left right & center . The #MeToo movement is good but one should remember that men can be victims too. Remember the Rohtak sisters?
@yashar Maybe she used the #metoo hash tag because of her personal sexual abuse experience.

@AunindyoC I might get a lot of flak for this but I have seen many girls misuse their charm to take advantage of boys. College Mai aur workplace Mai especially I have seen girls using boys to get their work done. So while the #MeToo movement is good, we need to listen to both sides.
@IndiaExplained Bade miyan toh bade miyan chote miyan subhanallah #MeToo

@chetan_bhagat @iratrivedi This #MeToo is very complicated. I can understand impoverished uneducated village women getting exploited by wealthy powerful men & keeping quiet. But why would educated girls from good families not speak as soon as they felt harassed? 1/2
